svg.title: MCP integration
svg.desc: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex and Cursor connect over MCP (stdio or Streamable HTTP) to one neuralgraph-memory server exposing seven read tools (memory_search, memory_context, memory_answer, memory_profile, memory_related, memory_entities, memory_status) and three write tools (memory_add_message, memory_remember, memory_forget).
